about.title: Evolution of a System Architect
paragraphs: I'm a multidisciplinary tech professional who thrives at the intersection of software engineering, data science, and monitoring & evaluation. My journey has taken me from writing my first lines of Python to architecting enterprise-grade data collection and analytics systems used by organizations worldwide.

I believe technology should serve a purpose — whether it's building a full-stack platform, designing an interactive Power BI dashboard, or deploying a digital survey system that collects critical data in remote communities. Every project I touch is engineered with precision and purpose.

contact.intro: Have an idea, a project, or a role in mind? I read every message and reply within a day.
